    good defensive tactics from milan, a little uninspired from psg who despite having some good cominations at times lacked the extra brilliance that wouldve been needed to crack that defense after 1-1. particularly dembele was, on 1 hand, the most incisive psg player carrying forward dangerously, but on the other hand his plays led to nothing - either blocked shots or terrible final passes. only 1 shot that hit the crossbar, maybe unlucky. on the other side of the pitch mbappe did not have any amazing moments after missing the 2 early chances which i have to say he shouldve scored but also his pace in getting there was insane. i noticed that there were always 2 players on him pinning him in the corner - the RB sideways ready to run with him, and another guy covering in case he turned inside. thats what happens when youre a pace merchant but theres no space to actually run into and u have to actually have that tight space dribbling technique to make the difference.
